knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: Path.is_file follows the link: the phase is complete with basis artifact

knownDivergences.cause: a stat of a planning file fails other than absent
knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: is_file swallows the OSError: the phase is pending

knownDivergences.javaAssertion: the index rule (FR-006): the first file wins and a malformed file is skipped with the wp_file_skipped diagnostic
knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: the default path lists a duplicate id twice and raises on a malformed file (stored per fixture in defaultPathOutcomes)

knownDivergences.cause: a symlinked Work Package file
knownDivergences.javaAssertion: the symlinked file is skipped with the wp_file_skipped diagnostic
knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: the default path follows the link and getMission lists it (stored in defaultPathOutcomes)

knownDivergences.cause: resolve_workspace_for_wp branches a stat cannot reproduce (an owned checkout, a persisted workspace context)

knownDivergences.cause: the walk bound of 100000 entries

knownDivergences.cause: a non-UTF-8 sun.jnu.encoding and a non-ASCII name (A8), and (M13) on the three index routes
knownDivergences.javaAssertion: listing 500 artifact_listing_unreadable; content 500 artifact_unreadable; index routes 500 source_unreadable
knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: the oracle lists and reads the name

knownDivergences.cause: an lstat of a path component fails other than absent while the artifact references are built (M9)
knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: the oracle follows links and swallows the error

knownDivergences.cause: lanes.json over 1 MiB (W3) and a review-cycle file over 262144 bytes (M11)
knownDivergences.javaAssertion: lanes.json: 500 source_unreadable; cycle file: an entry with null members
knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: the oracle has no cap on either: served and parsed

knownDivergences.cause: a non-nullable strict field, a class-3 human field or a history stamp that cannot be shown (M7)
knownDivergences.oracleOutcome: the stored text is served, or ProjectionError

knownDivergences.cause: a nullable head date that is not an instant (acceptedAt, mergedAt, discardedAt; #5529 ruling 1)

knownDivergences.cause: D-159 (d): a subtask status of genesis or uninitialized
knownDivergences.javaAssertion: the route mapper refuses it as a value outside StatusLane

knownDivergences.cause: D-159 (e): a history eventId, at or lane that is not text
knownDivergences.javaAssertion: its str() when Java reproduces it, else null, and refused by the mapper (T12, T13)

provisioning.ARTIFACT_REQUESTS: detail classes: one extra artifact path per line, requested from getArtifactContent beside every path of the listing (a path that is not in the listing: a missing file, a refused path)
provisioning.GITDIR_POINTER: exact text installed as the .git pointer file; gitdir-target/ is copied beside it with its own HEAD
provisioning.HEAD: exact text installed as .git/HEAD; no git init and no commit run
provisioning.PROVISION_PLAN: detail classes: a file at the fixture top level (never inside a Mission directory) of tab-separated, verb-first lines, applied to the temporary copy before the oracle runs and by the Java harness before the service runs; paths are relative to the project root and may not leave it. 'link<TAB>path<TAB>target' creates a symbolic link at path to target (a path relative to the project root; '@outside/x' points into a sibling directory created from the fixture's outside/ tree); 'gitentry<TAB>path' creates a plain file named by path (a .git entry; its content is irrelevant to a stat); 'mtime<TAB>path<TAB>epochSeconds' sets the modification time; 'dir<TAB>path' creates a directory (the lane worktrees of worktree-states); 'write<TAB>path<TAB>text' creates a file with that text as its content (a non-ASCII file name is made this way: a committed one stops the native-image test build, whose resource scan cannot decode it); 'substitute<TAB>path<TAB>marker<TAB>fragment...' replaces the marker text in the committed file by the concatenated fragments, so no host path, address or credential shape is committed whole. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. SYMLINK_PLAN keeps its own javaOnly grammar and is read exactly as before
provisioning.SYMLINK_PLAN: javaOnly: lines 'link<TAB>target' relative to the project root, created as symlinks at test time; a target starting with @outside/ points into a sibling directory created from the fixture's outside/ tree
provisioning.blank-line: a Mission whose ledger holds a blank line is served: read_events_raw skips the line and the overview counts the other events. Its streamCursor is the cursor after the whole file: offset = the file size, invariant = the SHA-256 of the last terminated line, a blank line included (tail_reader). malformed-rows/blank-line has the blank line mid-file; malformed-rows/blank-line-final ends the file with it, so its invariant is the digest of the bare newline and validate_resume_cursor and poll_once reject the non-blank digest. Only poll_once refuses the blank line, which the stream golden records
provisioning.coord-worktree: coord-worktree/<mission-dir>/ holds the contents of that Mission's coordination worktree ROOT (kitty-specs/<mission-dir>/...); installed at .worktrees/<slug>-<mid8>-coord as a registered git worktree (.worktrees/ is gitignored, so it cannot be committed in place)
provisioning.golden-keys: detail classes: every golden is one canonical-JSON object keyed by the request key: '-' for a Mission-level route, the Work Package id (WP99, a never-present id, is always requested from getWorkPackageDetail), or the artifact path. A value is the payload, {'status': n, 'body': {...}} for an operation that answers a status, or {'refusal': {...}} for an exception the oracle raised. The subject Mission of a fixture is the first directory, in name order, whose meta.json holds a mission_id
provisioning.husk-worktree: husk-worktree/<mission-dir>/ holds a stale coordination worktree; installed at the same .worktrees path as a plain unregistered directory
provisioning.not-copied: golden/, HEAD, GITDIR_POINTER, gitdir-target/, coord-worktree/, husk-worktree/, SYMLINK_PLAN, PROVISION_PLAN, ARTIFACT_REQUESTS and outside/ are provisioning inputs and are not copied into the project root as they are
provisioning.status.events.before.jsonl: a Mission-level status.events.before.jsonl is the earlier state of the log: the stream scenario polls it first, then polls status.events.jsonl with the resulting cursor
